caption:
The most nervous moment of a solo trip isn't the flight. It's the first hour after you land.

Everything is new at once. You're tired, you have your bags and you don't know the way. So make every decision before you leave home.

Five questions to answer and save offline 👇

Save this for your next trip. ✈️

#solotravel #solofemaletravel #womenwhotravel #travelalone #solotraveltips #travellingalone #booksforwomen #bookstagram

slides.title: The first hour after you land: 5 decisions to make at home.
slides.subtitle: So there's almost nothing to decide when you arrive.

slides.heading: How do I get to my room?
slides.body: Check the official airport or transport website. Note the route, the stops and how late it runs.

slides.heading: How will I pay for it?
slides.body: Card or phone at the gates? A machine? An app? If it's an app, set it up at home.

slides.heading: What does the last bit look like?
slides.body: Use street view to walk from the stop to the door. Arriving somewhere you've already seen is surprisingly calming.

slides.heading: How do I get in?
slides.body: Check-in time, reception or key box, and the hotel's phone number. Save it.

slides.heading: What will I do tonight?
slides.body: Pick a café or restaurant close by and a short walk. The first evening is the one most likely to feel strange.

slides.title: Save this for your next trip.
slides.body:
Write the answers in one note
and screenshot it.
